title: Provider hook commands quote only tokens that need it (PowerShell command position)
alternatives_rejected: Prefix the command with PowerShell's & call operator: invalid in POSIX sh and cmd, and hookCommand also feeds Cursor/Windsurf/Antigravity configs that other shells run.
Branch on process.platform at scaffold time: these hook configs are git-tracked and shared across a team, so a Windows-only shape would break Linux/macOS clones.
Leave it and document the workaround: the published npx invocation is what every installed user gets, so the DEFAULT path was broken for VS Code on Windows.
